description:
Fetch the full gnomAD population record for one or more variants — allele count/number/frequency overall and broken down per genetic-ancestry group, homozygote and hemizygote counts, quality flags, each callset's own counts and QC filters with a qc_status, the most severe transcript consequence beside the consequence on the gene's MANE Select (else canonical) transcript, in-silico predictor scores, and joined ClinVar clinical significance. The "how common, is it benign" answer in one call. A qc_status of filtered means the variant failed gnomAD QC in every callset carrying it (gnomAD's browser hides these by default; AC0 means no high-quality carrier), so treat its counts as low-confidence rather than an observed frequency. Accepts a batch of up to 25 IDs (chrom-pos-ref-alt or rsID) with per-item partial success: a malformed or absent ID lands in failed[] — with its reason and a recovery hint — without failing the others. A coordinate ID carries no build: an absent one whose string also lifts over from the other build fails as variant_not_found_other_build, with the lifted IDs on the dataset's build in candidates, while a string valid on both builds can name a different variant on each, which no not-found path can see — so keep IDs on the dataset's build. variant_not_found means the variant is not in the chosen dataset — pair with gnomad_get_coverage to confirm the position is callable before concluding true absence.
Data source: gnomAD (Broad Institute) — https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/

dataset.description: gnomAD dataset: gnomad_r4 (GRCh38, default), gnomad_r3 (GRCh38), gnomad_r2_1 (GRCh37), exac (GRCh37). Echoed in output.

reference_genome.description: Reference build. Derived from dataset when omitted (v4/v3=GRCh38, v2.1/ExAC=GRCh37). If supplied it must match the dataset, or the call is rejected. Keep aligned with ensembl coordinates.

variants.description: 1–25 variant IDs (chrom-pos-ref-alt or rsID) to look up in one batched call.

items.description: Variant ID — chrom-pos-ref-alt (1-based, e.g. 1-55051215-G-GA) on chromosome 1–22, X, or Y with an optional chr prefix, or an rsID (rs11591147). Mitochondrial IDs (M, MT, chrM) are not served. Obtain a variantId from ensembl_predict_variant or a VCF. Malformed IDs are reported per-item in failed[], not rejected wholesale.

name: gnomad_get_variant

dataset.description: Effective gnomAD dataset used for the batch.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incoherent_build`: reference_genome was supplied but does not match the dataset. `invalid_variant_id`: A variant ID is outside the chrom-pos-ref-alt or rsID grammar; reported per item in failed[]. `variant_not_found`: A well-formed ID is absent from the requested dataset with no liftover candidate from the other build: rsIDs are never lifted, and a liftover lookup that fails or runs out of time leaves this reason. Reported per item in failed[]. `variant_not_found_other_build`: A coordinate ID is absent from the requested dataset and, read as an ID on the other reference build, lifts over to the IDs in candidates on the dataset's build; reported per item in failed[]. `mitochondrial_unsupported`: A variant ID names the mitochondrial chromosome (M, MT, or chrM); reported per item in failed[]. `ambiguous_rsid`: An rsID maps to more than one variant in the dataset; reported per item in failed[]. `graphql_error`: gnomAD rejected the lookup for one ID with a GraphQL error; reported per item in failed[]. `upstream_build_mismatch`: gnomAD answered one ID with a variant on a different reference build; reported per item in failed[]. `upstream_unavailable`: gnomAD stayed unavailable or throttled through every retry for one ID; reported per item in failed[]. `upstream_timeout`: gnomAD attempts timed out or the shared 45 s batch budget expired for one ID; reported per item in failed[]. `upstream_access`: gnomAD refused the request for one ID (access denied); reported per item in failed[]. `invalid_upstream_response`: gnomAD kept answering one ID with a response that failed validation; reported per item in failed[]. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: Per-item failures, in input order: malformed IDs, variants absent from the dataset, or upstream errors — each with its reason and recovery hint.

items.description: One failed input ID, why it failed, and what to do next.

candidates.description: Concrete variant IDs to retry: for ambiguous_rsid, the chrom-pos-ref-alt IDs the rsID maps to; for variant_not_found_other_build, the IDs this string lifts over to on the dataset's reference build when read as an ID on the other build.

error.description: What went wrong for this ID.

reason.description: Why this ID failed — a reason declared in this tool's error contract. Branch on it rather than on the message.

recovery.description: The next step for this ID — the recovery hint declared for its reason.

variant.description: The input ID that failed to resolve.

found.description: Variants resolved to a population record.

items.description: Full population record for one variant.

ac.description: Overall allele count — gnomAD's joint exome + genome count on gnomad_r4, the sum across carried callset(s) on datasets without joint data.

af.description: Overall allele frequency, ac/an from the same source; null when an is 0.

an.description: Overall allele number. On gnomad_r4, gnomAD's joint AN over every callable sample in both callsets, including a callset that does not carry the variant; on gnomad_r3, gnomad_r2_1, and exac (no joint data), the sum across carried callset(s), a callset that failed QC included — callsets carries each one's own AN and filters.

callsets.description: Each callset's own AC/AN/AF and QC filters, beside the overall counts (which read gnomAD's joint record on gnomad_r4). A variant can fail QC in one callset and pass in the other.

ac.description: Allele count in this callset alone.

af.description: This callset's allele frequency, ac/an; null when an is 0.

an.description: Allele number in this callset alone.

filters.description: QC filters gnomAD applied to this callset's call — on gnomad_r4 AC0 (no high-quality carrier after genotype QC), AS_VQSR, InbreedingCoeff; the set varies by dataset (RF on gnomad_r2_1). Empty when the call passed QC; null when gnomAD returned no filter list.

hemizygote_count.description: Hemizygote count in this callset (0 off X/Y); null when gnomAD reports none.

exome.description: One callset's own counts and QC filters; null when that callset does not carry the variant (absent from source).

ac.description: Allele count in this callset alone.

af.description: This callset's allele frequency, ac/an; null when an is 0.

an.description: Allele number in this callset alone.

filters.description: QC filters gnomAD applied to this callset's call — on gnomad_r4 AC0 (no high-quality carrier after genotype QC), AS_VQSR, InbreedingCoeff; the set varies by dataset (RF on gnomad_r2_1). Empty when the call passed QC; null when gnomAD returned no filter list.

hemizygote_count.description: Hemizygote count in this callset (0 off X/Y); null when gnomAD reports none.

genome.description: One callset's own counts and QC filters; null when that callset does not carry the variant (absent from source).

anyOf.description: Joined ClinVar significance from gnomAD. Null when the variant has no ClinVar entry.

clinical_significance.description: ClinVar clinical significance (e.g. Pathogenic, Likely benign); null when no entry.

clinvar.description: ClinVar annotation, or null when no entry exists.

clinvar_unavailable.description: True when the ClinVar lookup failed or ran out of its time budget, so clinvar is null for want of an answer; false when it succeeded, with or without an entry.

consequence.description: The most severe VEP consequence term across the variant's transcripts, as gnomAD reports it; it can sit on a non-primary isoform, so read it beside primary_transcript. Null when none.

gene_symbol.description: Gene symbol for the reported consequence; null when none.

hemizygote_count.description: Overall hemizygote count, from the same source as ac and an (0 off X/Y); null when gnomAD reports none.

homozygote_count.description: Overall homozygote count, from the same source as ac and an.

in_silico.description: In-silico predictor scores present for this variant.

annotation.description: Text gnomAD attaches to the score — on gnomad_r3, the SpliceAI event (e.g. acceptor_gain, no_consequence). Holds the raw text when value is null for lack of a number; null for a plain score.

id.description: Predictor name. Ids vary by dataset — gnomad_r4: cadd, revel_max, spliceai_ds_max, pangolin_largest_ds, phylop, sift_max, polyphen_max; gnomad_r3: cadd, revel, splice_ai, primate_ai; gnomad_r2_1 and exac carry none.

value.description: Predictor score; null when not provided for this variant, or when gnomAD gave text with no number (the text is then in annotation).

joint_populations.description: Per-ancestry frequency vector of gnomAD's joint exome + genome data, over the same samples as the overall an. Empty on gnomad_r3, gnomad_r2_1, and exac, which publish no joint data.

items.description: One genetic-ancestry group's AC/AN/AF in gnomAD's joint exome + genome data.

af.description: Allele frequency (ac/an); null when an is 0.

an.description: Allele number (called chromosomes) in this group.

hemizygote_count.description: Hemizygote count in this group (0 off X/Y); null when gnomAD reports none.

id.description: Genetic-ancestry group: afr, amr, asj, eas, fin, mid, nfe, sas, ami (genomes only), and the catch-all group — remaining on gnomad_r4, oth on gnomad_r3, gnomad_r2_1, and exac.

populations.description: Per-ancestry frequency vector of each carrying callset — never collapsed to a single global AF.

af.description: Allele frequency (ac/an); null when an is 0.

an.description: Allele number (called chromosomes) in this group.

hemizygote_count.description: Hemizygote count in this group (0 off X/Y); null when gnomAD reports none.

id.description: Genetic-ancestry group: afr, amr, asj, eas, fin, mid, nfe, sas, ami (genomes only), and the catch-all group — remaining on gnomad_r4, oth on gnomad_r3, gnomad_r2_1, and exac.

source.description: Which gnomAD callset this group vector came from.

anyOf.description: The variant's consequence on its gene's primary transcript.

consequence.description: Most severe VEP consequence term on this transcript; null when none.

hgvsc.description: HGVS coding or transcript notation on this transcript (e.g. c.*9G>T); null when none.

hgvsp.description: HGVS protein notation on this transcript (e.g. p.Glu136Ter); null when gnomAD gives none, as for a UTR or intronic change.

is_mane_select.description: True when this is the gene's MANE Select transcript. For the canonical entry standing in: null where gnomAD reports no MANE status — a gene without a MANE Select (such as a lncRNA) on any dataset, and every gene on gnomad_r2_1 and exac (GRCh37) — else false.

lof.description: LOFTEE's loss-of-function call on this transcript (e.g. HC high-confidence, LC low-confidence); null when it made none.

primary_transcript.description: The consequence on the primary transcript of the consequence's gene: its MANE Select entry, else its canonical entry, from the transcript consequences gnomAD returns. Null when gnomAD lists neither entry for that gene — the variant lies outside both transcripts, e.g. on an exon only minor isoforms carry (CDKN2A's p14ARF exon 1β) — or when the variant has no transcript consequence.

qc_status.description: gnomAD's QC verdict, by its browser's rule: pass when at least one callset carrying the variant passed QC (empty filters); filtered when none did — gnomAD's browser hides these by default.

reference_genome.description: Reference build the record is on (GRCh38 or GRCh37).

source.description: Which gnomAD callset(s) carry this variant.

transcript_id.description: Ensembl transcript ID (unversioned) the consequence is on — not necessarily the gene's MANE Select or canonical transcript; null when none.

notice.description: Non-fatal notice when optional ClinVar annotation was unavailable.

reference_genome.description: Effective reference build used for the batch.

title: gnomad-genetics-mcp-server: get variant
